parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1741217. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, exact standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
